AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO SCHEDULE TO
WESTMARK TIMBER CORPORATION

This Amendment No. 1 amends and supplements the Tender Offer Statement on Schedule TO filed on September 2, 2026 relating to the offer by Westmark Timber Corporation to purchase for cash up to 900,000 shares of its common stock at a purchase price of $27.40 per share.

The Offer, previously scheduled to expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on October 1, 2026, has been extended and will now expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on October 16, 2026.

Odd Lots. The odd lot provisions of the Offer to Purchase are unchanged. Shareholders who own beneficially or of record fewer than 100 Shares and who validly tender all of those Shares will have their Shares accepted for purchase before proration, if any, of the Shares tendered by other shareholders.

Except as expressly amended by this Amendment, the Offer to Purchase remains in full force and effect.
